title: moves.json
description: Moves extracted from the source document. Written by the pipeline, never edited by the app.

moves.description: Flat list of tree nodes. Order carries no meaning; structure comes from parent_id.

title.description: Heading found above the moves, when one was identified.

initial_fen.description: Position before the first move. Standard start position unless the book sets up a study.

root_move_id.description: First move of the main line. Null for a diagram-only entry.

position_known.description: False when the book never printed where this game starts — analysis quoted after a result, or a run of pages opening in mid-score with no diagram to seed it. `initial_fen` is then a placeholder and every move is `broken`: the moves are kept for their boxes, so a reader can correct them, and nothing about them is scored.

parent_id.description: Move played immediately before. Null for a game's first move.

san.description: Move in standard algebraic notation, normalised to latin letters (KQRBN) whatever the printed notation.

uci.description: Long algebraic form, used by the app to highlight from/to. Null when status is broken.

fen.description: Position AFTER san is played. Null when status is broken.

ply.description: 1-based half-move index within the game, for labels like 12. or 12…

variation_index.description: 0 on the main line, >0 inside a variation. Distinguishes siblings of one parent.

comment.description: Prose attached to the move, when it was read as coherent.

status.description: ok: legal and unambiguous. uncertain: accepted after an OCR-style repair. broken: no legal reading.

repair.description: Present when status is uncertain: what the page actually showed, and what was substituted.

bbox.description: PDF user-space points, origin at the BOTTOM-LEFT of the rotated page. y is the box's bottom edge.
